## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

The failure-report selector should normalize paths when matching requested tests; otherwise, reports containing `./` prefixes omit matching failures. This review read both changed files and all available tests; no tests were run.

## Changes
The pull request adds failure-report selection and its tests, and refactors cached selection without changing its behavior.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/selection.py:20 — correctness — Normalize failure paths before matching — With `report={"failed": ["./tests/test_x.py"]}` and `requested={"tests/test_x.py"}`, your selector returns `[]` instead of `["./tests/test_x.py"]`. It compares raw paths, while `select_explicit` normalizes paths for matching and preserves their original spelling. — Users selecting failures recorded with `./` prefixes silently skip matching tests. — Fix: Compare `normalize(path)` against `requested` while returning the original `path`.
